title: TVT Mills pilot runtime metrics
description: The vendor delivery (see provenance.json) does not publish a metrics JSON schema -- management-api.openapi.yaml describes /metrics only as 'Runtime counters' with no shape. This is deliberately permissive rather than reverse-engineered from one observed payload; tighten it once a live deployment's actual /metrics output is captured, the same way the legacy traffic pack's metrics.schema.json was derived from its vendor.
